$comment: Wire vectors for contract/schema/bus-protocol.schema.json, added 2026-08-22 with the §9 mechanical-completion pass over protocol.md §6. EVERY CASE IS DERIVED FROM A §6 ROW AND CITES IT; none was taken from a server's replies, which is the direction §8 requires (the contract leads; the emulator implements against it). The point of the FAIL cases is that a schema which accepts everything certifies without checking: each one perturbs a PASS case in exactly one way the cited row forbids. ADDRESSES HERE ARE SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDERS, never real RAM addresses — a rebuild moves the RAM block, and D7's whole point is that a client resolves symbols live through emulator/lookup_symbol. Result documents are written WITHOUT the envelope fields; the runner merges `envelope` into every result case unless the case carries `envelopeDrop`. EVENT CASES (added 2026-08-26 by §11.21) carry `"group": "events"` and are merged with `eventEnvelope` instead: an event carries the §2.2 stamp and NEVER droppedEvents, which §2.3 makes a per-connection fact rather than a machine coordinate.
